title: Grade 5 French — Wed, Jun 03
description: La maison — Day 3 of 5: Prepositions of place (dans, sur, sous, devant, derrière)
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'dans' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Dans' = in / inside. 'Le chat est dans la boîte.' = The cat is in the box.

questions.question: What does 'sur' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Sur' = on / on top of. 'Le livre est sur la table.' = The book is on the table.

questions.question: What does 'sous' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Sous' = under / below. 'Le chat est sous le lit.' = The cat is under the bed.

questions.question: What does 'devant' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Devant' = in front of. 'La voiture est devant la maison.' = The car is in front of the house.

questions.question: What does 'derrière' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Derrière' = behind. 'Le jardin est derrière la maison.' = The garden is behind the house.

questions.question: What does 'à côté de' mean?
questions.explanation: 'À côté de' = next to / beside. 'La lampe est à côté du lit.' = The lamp is next to the bed.

questions.question: Complete: 'Le livre est ___ la table.' (The book is ON the table.)
questions.explanation: 'Sur' = on. 'Le livre est sur la table.'

questions.question: Complete: 'Le chat dort ___ le canapé.' (The cat sleeps UNDER the sofa.)
questions.explanation: 'Sous' = under. 'Le chat dort sous le canapé.'

questions.question: How do you ask 'Where is the cat?'
questions.explanation: 'Où est le chat?' = Where is the cat? 'Où' = where.

questions.question: Complete: 'Les vêtements sont ___ l'armoire.' (The clothes are IN the wardrobe.)
What does 'La voiture est devant le garage' mean?
options: The car is behind the garage
The car is in front of the garage
The car is in the garage
The car is under the garage
questions.explanation: 'Devant' = in front of. The car is in front of the garage.

questions.question: Complete: 'Le tableau est ___ le mur.' (The painting is ON the wall.)
questions.explanation: 'Sur' = on. 'Le tableau est sur le mur.'

questions.question: What does 'entre' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Entre' = between. 'La table est entre les deux chaises.' = The table is between the two chairs.

questions.question: Answer 'Où est le jardin?' if it is behind the house.
options: Le jardin est devant la maison.
Le jardin est derrière la maison.
Le jardin est dans la maison.
Le jardin est sur la maison.
questions.explanation: 'Le jardin est derrière la maison.' = The garden is behind the house.

questions.question: Complete: 'La lampe est ___ le lit.' (The lamp is NEXT TO the bed.)
questions.explanation: 'À côté de' + 'le' becomes 'à côté du'. 'La lampe est à côté du lit.'
